diagnosis.what_happened: Physical left alignment in LibreOffice Writer and Microsoft Word due to explicit <w:jc w:val="right"/>.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Agent emitted <w:jc w:val="right"/> inside <w:bidi w:val="1"/> paragraph and missed <w:sectPr><w:bidi/></w:sectPr>.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: Omit <w:jc> for right-aligned text under BiDi and ensure section properties declare <w:bidi/>.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Logical trailing-edge flip of w:val="right" inside BiDi contexts causes physical left alignment.

desired_behavior: For Right-aligned text under BiDi, omit <w:jc>. Ensure section properties declare <w:bidi/>. Use jc_val='both' only for narrative body.
generalization: In OpenXML BiDi contexts, explicit 'right' justification maps to the logical trailing edge (physical left). Avoid w:val='right' inside w:bidi.
